{{Quote|Dwynn Biuval, a sales representative of the Corellian Engineering Corporation, has kindly made a generous donation to the Commission for Rehabilitation of Unwanted Krahbu, a charity I administer. I want you to pick up this donation.|Daclif Gallamby|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Dwynn Biuval''' was a sales representative of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Biuval wished to provide [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]] a political contribution. To avoid unwanted publicity, Biuval made a donation to the [[Commission for the Rehabilitation of Unwanted Krahbu]] as a roundabout way to pay Diktat Gallamby.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNoble.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Dwynn Biuval]]
Dwynn Biuval was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Dwynn Biuval spawned under the generic "noble" template, Biuval's appearance was randomized under one of forty-two possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Biuval could appear as included [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue made no mention of Biuval's physical characteristics, the [[canon]]ical species and gender of Diuval cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
